forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: A local-exec Playwright candidate cannot modify project tests or config; project installation or source writes require a separate authorized workspace capability.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
A double is justified only at a real owned boundary and must preserve complete contract shapes and meaningful failures; mocking internals or adding test-only production APIs fails.
A local-exec Vitest candidate cannot modify project tests or config; project installation or source writes require a separate authorized workspace capability.
Assessment authority is read-only: no source repair, form submission with consequential state, account change, provider mutation, deployment, or finding closure is permitted.
inputs: Browser behaviors, test environments, risks, data, and automation acceptance goals.
A test design that requires dependency isolation or an existing test double.
A JavaScript or TypeScript unit or integration test project using Vitest.
A scannable site, audit CLI, permitted external read scope, and optional frozen baseline.
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 4 related modes: Design Playwright test source as a candidate artifact and execute or diagnose authorized existing Playwright tests without writing project source.; Assess or design the smallest behavior-focused test double boundary so tests use complete data shapes and do not pollute production interfaces.; Design Vitest test or configuration source as a candidate artifact and execute or diagnose authorized existing Vitest tests without writing project source.; Independently assess an authorized website using local and read-only external evidence across content, accessibility, SEO, performance, security signals, links, and behavior without remediation.
